edits.new:
Then a re-run of the review for the same date makes no second document, no second deliverFile call and no second request entry

  Scenario: AC9 A consumed call that fails or does not answer records nothing (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the rwb-integration activity deliverFile on task queue "rwb-integration" fails or does not answer for the manifest of "2026-11-30"
    When requestFileDelivery runs on queue "rwb-access"
    Then the failure returns to the workflow with no delivery recorded, no outcome entry written and no second call in that run
    Then the request is not recorded as delivered and the outcome listener writes no entry for the call

  Scenario: AC10 The rules with no scenario are held by the run (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the review run for "2026-11-30" with its fixture rows and the fakes of RWB-P2-E1007-CON
    When buildAccessReviewFile, requestFileDelivery and the outcome listener run
    Then the file name and layout are read from the interface row (BR4), one file is built per business date with the sha256 and the record count of the rows written (BR5), and the bytes are stored once through rwb-document (BR6)
    Then the manifest carries the fields of BR7, the request is one deliverFile call on rwb-integration (BR9) and one decision-record entry is written in the same transaction as the idempotency key (BR10)
    Then no transport, retry ladder, exception queue or owner task of rwb-integration or rwb-case is built or read (BR11), the delivered and failed entries carry the fields of BR13 and the failed alert goes only to the alert role (BR14)
    Then the item status is read only through GET /api/recovery/integration/v1/admin/outbound-items with a 2 s budget (BR16), no lake path is built (BR17), no SFTP class or second file copy is built (BR18), and only buildAccessReviewFile and requestFileDelivery run on queue "rwb-access" (BR1)
